blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds.
Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise.
We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings.
Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry.
Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks.
We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning.
We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets.
Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce.
Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks.
These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model.
Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT .
blocks.zh:
森林编目越来越依赖人工智能(AI)模型从大规模3D点云中获取森林属性.
目前的模式通常专门用于单一的任务、传感器和森林类型,使适应在说明、计算和专门知识方面代价高昂。
我们问,一个经过预先培训的单一模式是否可以在不同的森林库存环境中学习可转让的表述。
受语言建模和计算机视野的最新发展启发,我们朝着3D林业的基础模型(FM)迈出了一步。
使用字节 PT作为骨干,我们首先建立了一个强有力的有监督的基线,为森林语义学和实例分类、树种分类和年龄回归基准设定了一个新的最新技术。
然后我们管理一个大规模无标签的生物群, 覆盖空中、无人驾驶飞行器和移动激光扫描 跨越不同的森林生态系统, 利用自我监督的学习来培养同样的骨干。
我们系统地评估代表制学习战略,从零开始比较培训,在不同的注释预算下,对四个有代表性的林业任务进行有监督的预训和自我监督的预训。
与从零开始的训练相比,自我监督的预训加快了模型的趋同,并在说明缺乏时不断提高性能.
与具体任务监督的预训相比,自我监督的预训产生更多跨下游林业任务的可转移表述.
这些结论查明了预先培训过的表述最有价值的实际制度,并表明歧视而不是森林语义歧视是阻碍三维森林基础通用模式的主要障碍。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Forests play a central role in the global carbon cycle ( Mo et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) , biodiversity conservation ( Migliavacca et al., 2021 ; Skidmore et al., 2021 ) , climate regulation ( Forzieri et al., 2022 ; Anderegg et al., 2022 ) , and the global bioeconomy through timber production and forest-based industries ( Hua et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Pearse, 2026 ) , making accurate and scalable forest monitoring a scientific and societal priority.
Advances in remote sensing technology have enabled the observation of forests in great detail and at unprecedented scale. Satellite imagery, laser scanning (LiDAR) and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) make it possible to acquire measurements from individual trees to entire ecosystems ( Duncanson et al., 2022 ; Lang et al., 2023 ; Fogel et al., 2025 ; Maeda et al., 2025 ; Fareed et al., 2026 ) . In particular, 3D point clouds acquired by laser scanning capture detailed geometric properties of forests that can support fine-grained analysis of canopy structure ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , biomass ( Oehmcke et al., 2024 ; Borsah et al., 2023 ) , species composition ( Michałowska and Rapiński, 2021 ; Yip et al., 2024 ; Puliti et al., 2025 ) , and semantics ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Wielgosz et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) .
Such 3D data have become central to modern forest inventory and monitoring.
blocks.zh:
森林在全球碳循环(Mo等人,2023年;Pan等人,2024年),生物多样性保护(Migliavacca等人,2021年;Skidmore等人,2021年),气候调控(Forzieri等人,2022年;Anderegg等人,2022年)和通过木材生产和林基工业实现全球生物经济(Hua等人,2022年;Zhang and Pearse,2026年)中发挥着核心作用,使得准确和可扩展的森林监测成为科学和社会的优先事项。
遥感技术的进步使得能够非常详细地、以前所未有的规模观察森林。 卫星图像、激光扫描(LiDAR)和合成孔径雷达(SAR)使得有可能从个别树木获得对整个生态系统的测量(Duncanson等人,2022年;Lang等人,2023年;Fogel等人,2025年;Maida等人,2025年;Fareed等人,2026年)。 特别是,通过激光扫描获取的3D点云能够支持树冠结构精细分析的森林详细几何特征(Liu等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2024年),生物量(Oehmcke等人,2024年;Borsah等人,2023年),物种构成(Michawowska和Rapiński,2021年;Yip等人,2024年;Puliti等人,2025年),和语义学(Xiang等人,2024年;Wielgosz等人,2024年;Xiang等人,2025年)。
这种三维数据已成为现代森林清查和监测的核心。

blocks.en: Recent advances in forest-specific 3D computer vision are expanding the possibilities for fine-grained characterisation of forest ecosystems. A large part of the associated point cloud analysis can be understood as instances of well-studied machine learning tasks. Semantic segmentation assigns each point to a semantically meaningful class (e.g., ground, stem/wood, foliage, understory vegetation, or finer taxonomies), supporting component-wise measurements and ecological interpretation ( Puliti et al., 2023b ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Laino et al., 2026 ) . Instance segmentation separates the observed scene into individual trees, a prerequisite for determining tree-level attributes such as location, height, crown volume or diameter at breast height (DBH) ( Puliti et al., 2023b ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Cherlet et al., 2026 ) . Classification predicts attributes of single trees, like species or functional type ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Puliti et al., 2025 ) . Regression directly estimates tree- or stand-level biophysical variables like age or density ( Puliti et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近在针对森林的立体计算机愿景方面取得的进展正在扩大森林生态系统精细化的可能性。 关联点云分析的很大一部分可以理解为研究良好的机器学习任务的例子. 语义分解将每个点分配到一个有目的的类(如地面、干/木、叶片、底部植被或更细的分类),支持按组成部分进行测量和生态解释(Puliti等人,2023b); Shao等人,2024年;Lu等人,2025年;Laino等人,2026年). 实例分割将观测到的场景分割成单个树种,这是确定树级属性的前提,如位置,高度,胸高时的花冠体积或直径(Puliti等人,2023b;Xiang等人,2024;Xiang等人,2025;Cherlet等人,2026). 分类预测单树的属性,如物种或功能类型(Xiang等人,2024年;Puliti等人,2025年). 回归直接估计树状或立式生物物理变量,如年龄或密度(Puliti等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
The last few years have seen rapid progress in supervised deep learning tailored to forest point clouds, along with benchmark datasets that made it possible to quantitatively compare different methods. Xiang et al. (2024) developed ForAINet, a multi-task deep learning pipeline to segment high-density airborne LiDAR and derive tree/stand attributes from the segmented outputs. SegmentAnyTree by Wielgosz et al. (2024) targets a long-standing operational gap, transferability across different sensing platforms, by training a sensor-agnostic model. They also systematically analyze the performance for varying point densities and carrier platforms (ULS/TLS/MLS). With TreeLearn, Henrich et al. (2024) focus on instance segmentation from ground-based point clouds (including MLS) and highlight practical issues due to dense stands and crown overlap, as well as the impact of fine-tuning with a small amount of manual labels. ForestFormer3D ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) advances end-to-end learning for joint semantic and instance segmentation, with an emphasis on generalization to unseen forest regions and scan setups.
On the data side, SegmentedForests ( Laino et al., 2026 ) addresses the scarcity of labelled data for ground-based analysis by releasing a large, curated TLS/MLS dataset of semantically annotated forest plots.
FOR-instance ( Puliti et al., 2023b ; Puliti et al., 2023a ) provides a curated laser scanning benchmark with manual instance annotations and semantic classes, designed to standardize the evaluation of tree segmentation methods across multiple forest types and regions.
PureForest ( Gaydon and Roche, 2025 ) provides a benchmark dataset for tree species classification at the forest patch level using ALS point clouds and aerial images.
FOR-species20K ( Puliti et al., 2025 ) targets tree species classification at scale by collating and standardizing more than 20 20 k taxonomically diverse individual-tree point clouds.
FOR-age ( Puliti et al., 2026 ) offers a high-density laser-scanning dataset of individual trees with annotated age and explores the application of deep learning methods for tree age prediction.
blocks.zh:
在过去几年中,在根据森林点云量身定做的有监督的深入学习方面取得了迅速进展,同时建立了基准数据集,从而有可能对不同方法进行定量比较。 Xiang等人(2024年)开发了Forainet,一个多任务深层学习管道,用于分解高密度空载LiDAR,并从分解输出中获取树/立属性. 由Wielgosz等人(2024年)制作的ScidesAnyTree通过培训一个传感器不可知模型,瞄准一个长期存在的操作缺口,跨不同遥感平台的可转移性. 他们还系统分析不同点密度和载体平台(ULS/TLS/MLS)的性能. 与TreeLearn,Henrich等人(2024年)集中从地基点云(包括MLS)进行实例分解,并突出显示由于站台密集和冠重重叠而产生的实际问题,以及用少量人工标签微调的影响. ForestFormer3D(Xiang 等人,2025年)推进端到端的学习,进行联合语义学和实例分解,重点是向看不见的森林区域进行概括和扫描设置.
在数据方面,Scidesed Forests(Laino等人,2026年)通过发布大量有说明的森林地块的TLS/MLS数据集,解决了地面分析缺乏标签数据的问题。
FOR-Intance(Puliti等人,2023年b;Puliti等人,2023年a)提供了具有人工实例说明和语义类的经理激光扫描基准,旨在将多种森林类型和地区的树分方法评价标准化。
纯森林(Gaydon and Roche, 2025)利用ALS点云和航空图像为森林补丁级树种分类提供了基准数据集.
For-species20K(Puliti等人,2025年)通过整理和规范20多个20k种分类多样性个体-树点云,在规模上瞄准树种分类.
For-age(Puliti等人,2026年)提供了具有注释年龄的个别树木的高密度激光扫描数据集,并探索运用深层学习方法进行树龄预测.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, current models tend to be developed and fitted from scratch for specific variables of interest and for particular forest characteristics, and struggle to generalize. The paradigm of foundation models tries to overcome the narrow specialization and instead provide models that can handle a variety of ecosystems, scanning setups and analysis tasks.
Broadly speaking, there are two ways to construct a foundational model. The first is to collect and annotate training data from diverse forest types and sensing conditions, such that data-driven learning will naturally lead to a model able to operate across the entire range of conditions encountered during training. This approach has been employed successfully in domains like image understanding, where large annotated data collections are relatively easy to assemble ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 , e.g.,) . Recent data collection efforts like FOR-instanceV2 and FOR-species20K aim in that direction and could form a starting point to produce foundation models for forest point clouds. Still, the classical fully supervised approach is hampered by the large effort needed to produce high-quality annotations, which is not only labour-intensive but also requires specific expertise.
To alleviate this bottleneck, a recent line of work has developed synthetic forest point cloud generation pipelines and demonstrated that supervised pretraining on these synthetic datasets can reduce the amount of real labelled data required for forest segmentation tasks ( She et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
Nevertheless, the synthetic-to-real transfer gap remains an open challenge, and it is unclear whether representations learned from synthetic data for segmentation transfer effectively to other downstream forestry tasks. Moreover, for many target variables and geographies, labelled ground-truth data remain scarce, particularly when it comes to more subtle ecological attributes like tree age. In contrast, unlabelled point clouds are nowadays abundant due to sensor automation. The second strategy, which forms the basis of the recent AI revolution in disciplines like language processing ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Comanici et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 , e.g.,) and computer vision ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 , e.g.,) , relies on self-supervised learning, where models are pre-trained on even larger collections of data without labels to learn their inherent patterns and structures. The goal is a model that is able to operate across a broad range of forest and sensing conditions and that abstracts the input point cloud into an embedding ; i.e., a generic representation that retains its characteristic, informative features, such that only a small amount of annotated data is needed to adapt it to a concrete forest type and analysis task.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但目前的模型往往会从零开始为感兴趣的具体变量和特定森林特征开发和安装,并努力加以概括。 基础模型的范式试图克服狭隘的专业化,而是提供能够处理各种生态系统,扫描设置和分析任务的模型.
广义而言,构建基础模型有两种方式. 首先是收集和说明来自不同森林类型和感知条件的培训数据,这样,数据驱动的学习自然将形成一个能够在培训期间遇到的所有条件中运作的模式。 这种方法在图像理解等领域得到成功应用,在这些领域,大型附加说明的数据收集相对容易组装(Kirillov等人,2023年;Yang等人,2024年,例如). 最近的数据收集工作,如FOR-IntanceV2和FOR-species20K,就是朝这个方向努力,可以形成一个起点,为森林点云产生基础模型。 然而,传统的全面监督办法受到阻碍,因为需要作出大量努力来编写高质量的说明,这不仅是劳动密集型的,而且需要具体的专门知识。
为缓解这一瓶颈,最近一行工作开发了合成林点云生成管道,并证明对这些合成数据集进行有监督的预训可以减少森林分解任务所需的真实标注数据的数量(She等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年)。
尽管如此,合成到实际的转移差距仍然是一个公开的挑战,目前尚不清楚的是,从合成数据中汲取的表述是否有效地转移到其他下游林业任务。 此外,对于许多目标变量和地理图来说,贴有标签的地面真实数据仍然很少,特别是在树龄等更微妙的生态属性方面。 相比之下,由于传感器自动化,未加标签的点云现今已经丰富。 第二项战略是最近AI在语言处理等学科革命的基础(Achiam等人,2023年;Comanici等人,2025年;Liu等人,2024年;例如)和计算机视觉(Radford等人,2021年;Oquab等人,2024年;Siméoni等人,2025年;例如),依靠自我监督的学习,在没有标签的更大数据收集上对模型进行预先培训,以学习其固有的规律和结构。 目标是一个能够跨越广泛的森林和感知条件运行的模型,并将输入点云集成嵌入式;即通用的表示方式,保留其特征,信息性特征,因此只需少量附加说明的数据即可适应具体的森林类型和分析任务.

blocks.en:
We note that a similar trend towards large-scale, self-supervised pretraining has emerged in satellite remote sensing ( Brown et al., 2025 ; Jakubik et al., 2025 ; Astruc et al., 2025 ; Plekhanova et al., 2025 ; Szwarcman et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Tolan et al., 2024 ; Bodnar et al., 2025 ) .
As part of the same trend, image-based methods in forestry have started to adapt pretrained foundation models, for instance for disturbance mapping from Sentinel-1 radar imagery ( Tian et al., 2025 ) and for tree crown segmentation in ground-based ( Duguay et al., 2026 ) as well as aerial imagery ( Teng et al., 2025 ) .
Moreover, neural network models for satellite imagery have been pretrained specifically for forestry applications, e.g., Tolan et al. (2024) train an encoder for VHR Maxar imagery, followed by a dense prediction decoder that outputs canopy height maps. FoMo ( Bountos et al., 2025 ) follows the masked autoencoding paradigm ( He et al., 2022 ) to pretrain a forest foundation model for multiple remote sensing modalities, including optical and multispectral satellite imagery, aerial imagery, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR). SSL4Eco ( Plekhanova et al., 2025 ) explores the pretraining of ecological representations from satellite imagery.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,在卫星遥感方面出现了大规模、自我监督的预先训练的类似趋势(Brown等人,2025年;Jakubik等人,2025年;Astruc等人,2025年;Plekhanova等人,2025年;Szwarcman等人,2025年;Guo等人,2024年;Tolan等人,2024年;Bodnar等人,2025年)。
作为同一趋势的一部分,林业中以图像为基础的方法已开始调整经过预先培训的基础模型,例如用于Sentinel-1雷达图象的扰动图象(Tian等人,2025年)和地面树冠分割图象(Duguay等人,2026年)以及航空图象(Teng等人,2025年)。
此外,卫星图像的神经网络模型已经经过预先培训,专门用于林业应用,例如Tolan等人。 (2024)为VHR Maxar图像训练一个编码器,然后是输出树冠高度图的密集预测解码器. FoMo(Bountos等人,2025年)遵循蒙面自动编码范式(He等人,2022年),为多种遥感模式,包括光学和多光谱卫星图像、航空图像和合成孔径雷达(SAR)预演一个森林基础模型。 SSL4Eco(Plekhanova等人,2025年)探索了卫星图像对生态表现的预先训练.

blocks.en:
Compared with imagery, large-scale representation learning for 3D forest point clouds remains far less explored, despite the central role of LiDAR in practical forest economy and ecology. Notable recent exceptions include Opler et al. (2026) and Rizaldy et al. (2026) , which we discuss in more detail below.
In the present work, we curate a large unlabelled dataset of forest point clouds
and investigate both fully supervised and self-supervised training of point cloud encoders across a range of forest types and mapping tasks.
We base our models on LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) , a state-of-the-art architecture for 3D point cloud processing, and refer to the resulting family of forest-pretrained models as ForPT.
blocks.zh:
与图像相比,尽管LiDAR在实际森林经济和生态学中发挥了中心作用,但3D森林点云的大规模代表性学习仍然远未被探索. 最近的显著例外包括Opler等人(2026年)和Rizaldy等人(2026年),我们将在下文详细讨论这些例外。
在目前的工作中,我们整理了一大组没有标记的森林点云数据
并调查在一系列森林类型和测绘任务中对点云编码器进行充分监督和自我监督的培训。
我们的模型以LitePT(Yue et al., 2026)为基础,这是三维点云处理的最先进的建筑,并将由此形成的林预模型家族称为ForPT.

blocks.en:
Our experiments span four forest-related point cloud understanding tasks, including semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, tree age prediction, and tree species classification.
For each task we consider three different settings:
(i) the conventional, fully supervised learning from the currently available, public labelled datasets;
(ii) the strict foundation model setting, where the model is pretrained with self-supervision, then frozen and used to extract an embedding that is fed to a task-specific head, typically a linear layer, a.k.a. “linear probing”;
(iii) the combined setting, where the pretrained foundation model is fine-tuned in fully supervised fashion together with the output head.
The experiments indicate that fully supervised training from scratch can be viable if diversity is moderate (e.g., only European temperate forest) and sufficient data is available (e.g., ≈ \approx 10,000 segmented and labelled tree instances); but that representations derived with self-supervised learning transfer effectively and boost performance especially in the low-data regime.
Furthermore, among pretraining strategies, a single self-supervised pretrained backbone yields stronger cross-task transfer than task-specific supervised pretraining.
We conclude that self-supervised learning is an important ingredient for the next step: to create truly foundational forest point cloud models, applicable at continental or global scale, with realistic annotation budgets.
The robustness of self-supervised representation learning is particularly encouraging with a view towards practical applications, where neither the volume of reference annotations nor the compute resources may be available to train large contemporary AI models from scratch.
The main contributions of this study are fourfold:
blocks.zh:
我们的实验涉及四个与森林有关的点云理解任务,包括语义分化、实例分化、树龄预测和树种分类。
对于每项任务,我们考虑三种不同的设置:
(一) 全面监督地从现有公共标有标签的常规数据集学习;
(二)严格的奠基模型设置,该模型先用自我监督进行预训,然后被冷冻并用于提取一个嵌入到任务特定头部,一般是线性层,a.k.a. “线性探测”;
(三)结合设置,对经过预训的基础模型与输出头一起进行充分监督的微调.
实验表明,如果多样性是中等的(例如只有欧洲温带森林),并且有足够的数据(例如,\\\ 大约 1万个分块和标签树例),从零开始充分监督的培训是可行的;但是,通过自我监督的学习转移而得出的表述可以有效提高绩效,特别是在低数据制度中。
此外,在培训前战略中,单一的自我监督的预先培训骨干比具体任务的监督培训更能促进交叉任务转移。
我们的结论是,自我监督的学习是下一步的重要内容:创造真正具有基础的森林点云模型,适用于大陆或全球范围,并有现实的注释预算。
自我监督的代表性学习的扎实性特别令人鼓舞,着眼于实际应用,在实际应用中,既无法提供参考说明的数量,也无法提供计算资源,从头开始培训当代大型AI模型。
这项研究的主要贡献有四方面:

blocks.en:
• We construct a large-scale, curated dataset of unlabelled forest LiDAR point clouds for self-supervised pretraining, and establish a dedicated evaluation protocol for 3D forestry representation learning. • Using the LitePT backbone, we establish a new state of the art for forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and tree age regression under supervised training. • We pretrain the same backbone on unlabelled 3D forest point clouds using a self-distillation approach and systematically compare it against training from scratch and supervised pretraining under varying annotation budgets. • We show that self-supervised pretraining is most effective in low-data regimes and learns more transferable representations than task-specific supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, informing the design of future 3D forest foundation models. Recent related work. A concurrent study by Opler et al. (2026) investigates self-supervised learning on single-tree point clouds for above-ground biomass (AGB) estimation. More closely related to our work, a concurrent effort by Rizaldy et al. (2026) also pretrains models on unlabelled forest LiDAR and evaluates them under reduced supervision. They reach similar conclusions: pretraining is most beneficial when labels are scarce, while current self-supervised objectives do not yet yield strongly instance-discriminative representations.
Notably, the findings are in agreement despite marked technical differences: Rizaldy et al. (2026) pretrain separate sparse U-Net models with a contrastive learning objective for forest segmentation and tree species classification; whereas we pretrain a point transformer with self-distillation, employ a single encoder across all four tasks, and evaluate fully supervised pretraining under the same protocol.

blocks.en: 2.1 Unlabelled data for self-supervised learning
blocks.zh: 2.1 自我监督学习的无标签数据

blocks.en: Data sources. To compile a large and diverse collection of forest LiDAR datasets for self-supervised learning, we relied both on NIBIO legacy datasets and on existing open data available from public repositories. The resulting corpus spans multiple geographic regions, forest types, sensor modalities and acquisition conditions. The dataset covers a total forest area of approximately 160 km 2 of forest ( ≈ 15,900 \approx 15,900 ha) and contains ≈ 33 \approx 33 billion LiDAR points, with an average point density of ≈ 200 \approx 200 points / m 2 . The pretraining corpus is disjoint from downstream task data, preventing data leakage between pretraining and downstream evaluation.
blocks.zh: 数据来源. 为了汇编大量和多样化的森林LiDAR数据集,供自我监督的学习,我们依靠NIBIO遗留数据集和公共储存库现有的开放数据。 由此形成的生物体跨越多个地理区域、森林类型、传感器模式和获取条件。 数据集覆盖了森林总面积约160 km 2 (≈ 15 900 \ 约 15 900 ha),包含 ≈ 33 \ 约 330 亿 LiDAR 点,平均点密度为 ≈ 200 \ 约 200 点 / m 2 . 预训程序与下游任务数据脱节,防止了预训与下游评价之间的数据泄漏.

blocks.en: Geographical distribution. The pretraining sites are geographically distributed across multiple continents, including Europe, North America, South America, Africa, and Oceania. Most sites are concentrated in Europe, where dense coverage from different acquisition platforms enables diverse forest conditions and scanning scenarios to be represented. Additional sites outside Europe increase environmental variability. The dataset includes various forest types, including alpine/montane, boreal, temperate, and tropical ecosystems, ensuring diversity in vegetation structure and species composition.
blocks.zh: 地域分布. 预训场分布于多个大陆,包括欧洲,北美,南美,非洲和大洋洲. 大多数地点都集中在欧洲,从不同的收购平台获取的密集覆盖使得能够反映不同的森林条件和扫描情景。 欧洲以外的其他地点增加了环境的可变性。 数据集包括各种森林类型,包括高山/高山、北冰洋、温带和热带生态系统,以确保植被结构和物种构成的多样性。

blocks.en:
Multi-modality and sensor diversity. Our collection integrates multiple LiDAR acquisition modalities, including airborne laser scanning (ALS), mobile laser scanning (MLS), and unmanned laser scanning (ULS). This diversity exposes the model to varying point densities, noise characteristics, and viewpoints, facilitating the development of sensor-agnostic representations.
Among these modalities, ALS constitutes the primary data source due to its scalability and ease of acquisition compared with other sensing platforms, making it particularly well suited for large-scale self-supervised pretraining.
blocks.zh:
多式联运和传感器多样性。 我们的收藏融合了多种LiDAR的获取方式,包括空中激光扫描(ALS),移动激光扫描(MLS),无人激光扫描(ULS). 这种多样性使模型暴露在不同的点密度、噪声特征和观点上,促进了传感器不可知性表示的发展。
在这些模式中,ALS由于与其他遥感平台相比其可伸缩性和易获取性而成为主要数据来源,因此它特别适合大规模自我监督的预训.

blocks.en: Preprocessing. Due to variations in sensing platforms, acquisition conditions, some point clouds contain substantial noise and isolated artifacts. To improve data quality and consistency, we apply statistical outlier removal as a preprocessing step. The unlabelled forest dataset consists of large-scale point cloud tiles, each typically covering spatial extents of 200 ​ m × 200 ​ m 200~\mathrm{m}\times 200~\mathrm{m} , which are computationally prohibitive to process directly with deep learning models. We therefore subdivide each tile into smaller 20 ​ m × 20 ​ m 20~\mathrm{m}\times 20~\mathrm{m} spatial patches.
blocks.zh: 预处理. 由于感知平台的变化,获取条件,一些点云中含有大量噪声和孤立的文物. 为了提高数据质量和一致性,我们采用统计外除作为预先处理步骤。 无标签的森林数据集由大尺度的点云瓦组成,每块通常覆盖200米×200米200~\马特尔姆{米}\时间200~\马特尔姆{米}的空间范围,从计算上来说,它们对于用深层学习模型直接处理是令人无法接受的. 因此,我们把每块瓷砖细分为较小的20米×20米 20~\mathrm{ m}\times 20~\mathrm{ m}空间补丁.

blocks.en: 2.2 Labelled downstream task data
blocks.zh: 2.2 下游任务数据

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Forest semantic and instance segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 国家 森林语义和实例分类

blocks.en: We utilize FOR-instanceV2 dataset ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , Figure 2 (a), a large-scale forest dataset that extends the earlier FOR-instance dataset ( Puliti et al., 2023b ) . It provides unique individual tree IDs for each point, as well as semantic labels for ground, wood, and leaf. The data were collected across multiple countries, including Norway, the Czech Republic, Austria, French Guiana, New Zealand, and Australia, and encompass ULS, MLS, TLS point cloud modalities. Overall, this dataset comprises 48 training plots, 17 validation plots, and 29 test plots, totalling 11,028 tree instances.
blocks.zh: 我们使用FOR-InstanceV2数据集(Xiang等人,2025年),图2(a),一个大规模森林数据集,扩展了早先的FOR-Instance数据集(Puliti等人,2023年b)。 它为每个点提供了独特的个别树标识,以及地面,木材,和叶片的语义标记. 数据是在多个国家收集的,包括挪威、捷克共和国、奥地利、法属圭亚那、新西兰和澳大利亚,包括ULS、MLS、TLS点云模式。 总的来说,该数据集包括48个训练地块、17个验证地块和29个试验地块,共计11 028个树木实例。

blocks.en: While this dataset provides a sufficiently large and diverse set of labelled forest plots, the annotation process requires substantial human efforts. In real-world forestry applications, access to large-scale annotated data is often limited. In contrast, this work focuses on developing a forest point cloud foundation model that can be effectively adapted to downstream applications with only a small amount of labelled data. To better reflect this practical setting, we partition the training data into multiple subsets with varying proportions (5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 100%) and report performance across these regimes. This protocol enables a more comprehensive assessment of model generalization and data efficiency, and establishes a more suitable benchmark to evaluate forest point cloud foundation models.
blocks.zh: 虽然该数据集提供了足够大和多样的一组有标记的森林地块,但注释过程需要大量的人力努力。 在现实世界的林业应用中,获得大规模注释数据的机会往往有限. 相比之下,这项工作的重点是开发一个森林点云基模型,能够有效地适应只有少量标签数据的下游应用. 为了更好地反映这一实际环境,我们把培训数据分成不同比例的多个子集(5%、10%、20%、50%、100%),并报告这些制度的绩效。 这项协议有助于更全面地评估模型的通用性和数据效率,并为评价森林点云基模型建立一个更适当的基准。

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Tree species classification
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 树种分类

blocks.en:
For this task, where tree species labels are assigned to (segmented) scans of individual trees, we use the FOR-species20K ( Puliti et al., 2025 ) , Figure 2 (b). This dataset is primarily collected in Europe, with additional samples from Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, and covers TLS, ULS, and MLS sensor modalities.
FOR-species20K contains 33 species, with Pinus sylvestris and Fagus sylvatica being the most common, while others such as Populus deltoides , Corylus avellana , Prunus avium are underrepresented.
This dataset is highly imbalanced and its distribution reflects realistic species abundance in European forest ecosystems, where dominant tree species are prevalent and rarer species occur less frequently.
The full dataset is split into a development set (90%, 17,707 trees) and test set (10%, 2,255 trees). The development set is further divided into 14,165 trees for training and 3,542 trees for validation.
blocks.zh:
在这项任务中,在树种标签被指定用于个别树种的扫描(有部分)时,我们使用FOR-species20K(Puliti等人,2025年),图2(b)。 此数据集主要在欧洲采集,另外还有来自加拿大,澳大利亚和新西兰的样本,涵盖TLS,ULS,和MLS传感器模式.
For-species20K包含33个物种,其中Pinus sylvestris和Fagus sylvatica最为常见,而其他物种如Populus deltoides , Corylus avellana , Prunus avium 则代表性不足.
该数据集高度失衡,其分布反映了欧洲森林生态系统中现实的物种丰度,其中主要树种盛行,稀有物种较少出现.
完整的数据集分为开发集(90%,17,707棵树)和测试集(10%,2,255棵树). 开发组又分为14,165棵用于训练的树和3,542棵用于验证的树.

blocks.en:
FOR-species20K represents the most comprehensive and largest dataset regarding the number of tree species openly available to date, providing a strong benchmark for developing and evaluating robust classification models.
However, similar to the segmentation setting, real-world applications often lack access to large-scale data. To better assess the ability of foundation models to adapt under limited supervision, we partition the training set into subsets with varying proportions (1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 100%) and conduct a comprehensive evaluation across these regimes.
blocks.zh:
FOR-species20K是迄今公开提供的关于树种数量的最全面和最大的数据集,为制定和评价健全的分类模型提供了一个强有力的基准。
然而,与分区设置类似,现实世界的应用程序往往缺乏大规模数据的访问. 为了更好地评估基金会模型在有限监督下进行调整的能力,我们把培训分成比例不同的子集(1%、5%、10%、20%、50%、100%),并在这些制度中进行全面评价。

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Tree age estimation
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 国家 树龄估计

blocks.en: For single-tree age regression, we use the FOR-age dataset ( Puliti et al., 2026 ) , Figure 2 (c). The dataset is collected from Norway and Finland, covering MLS, TLS, and ALSHD sensor modalities. In total, it comprises 1,775 tree scans spanning an age range of up to 350 years, with an average of 53 years. The dataset exhibits a long-tailed distribution, including seedling and saplings (6% of trees younger than 10 years), established forests (50% between 10 and 50 years), trees at typical harvesting maturity (28% between 50 and 100 years), older trees (9% between 100 and 200 years) and a small portion of very old trees (2% older than 200 years). The dataset is split into 1,250 trees for training, 271 trees for validation, and 254 trees for testing. Similar with species classification, we split the training set into subsets with varying proportions (5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 100%) for data efficiency experiments.
blocks.zh: 对于单树龄回归,我们使用For-age数据集(Puliti等人,2026年),图2(c)。 数据集从挪威和芬兰收集,涵盖MLS,TLS,以及ALSHD传感器模式. 共有1 775个树扫描,年龄范围为350岁,平均53岁。 数据集显示了长尾分布,包括幼苗和树苗(占10岁以下树木的6%)、既定森林(占10至50岁树龄的50%)、典型采伐成熟的树木(占50至100岁树龄的28%)、较老的树木(占100至200岁树龄的9%)和一小部分非常老的树木(占200岁以上树龄的2%)。 数据集分为1 250棵用于培训的树木、271棵用于验证的树木和254棵用于测试的树木。 与物种分类类似,我们把培训分为不同比例的子集(5%、10%、20%、50%、100%),用于数据效率实验。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
We investigate two pretraining strategies, self-supervised and supervised pretraining, to assess their ability to learn transferable representations for forest point clouds and their potential as a step toward a 3D forest foundation model.
For both strategies, a common LitePT backbone is first pretrained and then transferred to downstream forestry tasks through either frozen feature transfer or end-to-end fine-tuning. For comparison, we also train the same backbone from scratch on each downstream task. This unified framework enables a systematic comparison of alternative representation learning strategies under identical transfer learning protocols and annotation budgets.
The following sections describe the two pretraining strategies ( Sections 3.2 and 3.3 ), the transfer learning protocol ( Section 3.4 ) and the pretraining implementation ( Section 3.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们调查了两项训练前战略,即自我监督和监督的训练前战略,以评估它们学习森林点云的可转移表述的能力,以及它们作为三维森林基础模式的一个步骤的潜力。
对于这两种战略,一个通用的LitePT主干线首先经过预先培训,然后通过冷冻特性转移或端到端的微调转移到下游林业任务. 作为比较,我们还从头开始对下游的每一项任务进行同样的骨干培训。 这一统一框架能够系统地比较在相同的转移学习规程和注解预算中的替代性代表学习战略。
以下各节介绍两个培训前战略(第3.2和3.3节)、转移学习规程(第3.4节)和培训前实施(第3.5节)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Self-supervised pretraining
blocks.zh: 3.2 自我监督的预训

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Self-supervised pretraining workflow. A large-scale unlabelled forest point cloud corpus is curated and preprocessed. The LitePT backbone is then pretrained using teacher-student self-distillation. Finally, the pretrained encoder is applied to downstream forestry tasks through transfer learning.
blocks.zh: 图3:自监预训工作流程. 大规模无标签的林点云体经过整理和预处理. 然后,LitePT骨干采用师生自我消化法进行预训。 最后,预先训练的编码器通过转移学习应用于下游林业任务.

blocks.en: The overall self-supervised pretraining workflow is illustrated in Figure 3 . First, we curate a large-scale unlabelled forest point cloud dataset and perform data preprocessing and standardization to obtain a unified representation suitable for neural network training. Next, the LitePT backbone is pretrained using self-supervised learning. Finally, the pretrained encoder is transferred to downstream forestry tasks using the transfer learning protocol described in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 图3说明了自控培训前工作流程的总体情况。 首先,我们管理一个大规模无标签的森林点云数据集,并进行数据预处理和标准化,以获得适合神经网络培训的统一代表. 接下来,LitePT骨干采用自学方式进行预训. 最后,使用第3.4节所述的转移学习规程,预先训练的编码器转移到下游林业任务。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Self-supervised pretraining pipeline. The framework follows a teacher-student architecture, where a student network is trained to match the outputs of a momentum-updated teacher network.
blocks.zh: 图4:自行监管的预训管道. 该框架采用师生结构,对学生网络进行培训,使其与更新势头的教师网络的产出相匹配。

blocks.en:
The self-supervised learning architecture is shown in Figure 4 . We adopt a self-distillation framework inspired by DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) and its point cloud adaptation Sonata ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and tailor it to the structural characteristics of forest point clouds.
The overall architecture follows a student-teacher paradigm, where the student network is trained to match the output of a momentum-updated teacher network under multiple geometric views of the same input point cloud.
blocks.zh:
自行监管的学习架构如图4所示. 我们采用了由DINOv2(Oquab等人,2024年)及其点云适应索纳塔(Wu等人,2025年)启发的自我消化框架,并根据森林点云的结构特征进行调整.
整体架构遵循学生-教师模式,学生网络在同一个输入点云的多个几何视图下接受培训,以匹配动力更新的教师网络输出.

blocks.en:
Multi-view augmentation. Given a forest point cloud pre-chunked into 20 ​ m × 20 ​ m 20~\mathrm{m}\times 20~\mathrm{m} spatial tiles, we construct multiple stochastic views for self-supervised learning. Formally, for an input forest chunk x x , we generate a set 𝒱 \mathcal{V} of different views, consisting of two global views with large spatial support, 𝒱 g = { x i g } i = 1 2 \mathcal{V}_{g}=\{x_{i}^{g}\}_{i=1}^{2} and four local views with smaller crops, 𝒱 l = { x i l } i = 1 4 \mathcal{V}_{l}=\{x_{i}^{l}\}_{i=1}^{4} .
The global views retain most of the spatial extent of the original chunk, while the local views focus on partial regions, simulating incomplete observations commonly encountered in forest point clouds due to occlusion and varying sampling density.
All views are independently augmented using a set of geometric transformations, including random scaling, rotation, flipping, point jittering, and elastic distortion. These augmentations aim to enforce invariance to acquisition conditions and geometric perturbations while preserving the underlying forest semantics.
In addition, random patch masking ( He et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) is applied to the two global views to further increase task difficulty and promote contextual reasoning. Specifically, a subset of spatial patches is randomly removed from each global view, resulting in two masked global views, 𝒱 ^ g = { x ^ i g } i = 1 2 \mathcal{\hat{V}}_{g}=\{\hat{x}_{i}^{g}\}_{i=1}^{2} . The masking strategy encourages the model to infer missing structure from partial observations, improving robustness to sparsity and occlusion commonly observed in LiDAR data.

blocks.en: Specifically, we pretrain the same LitePT backbone independently on each of the four downstream tasks: forest semantic segmentation, forest instance segmentation, tree species classification, and tree age regression, using the same training procedures as the corresponding training-from-scratch baseline. After pretraining, the task-specific decoder or head is discarded, and the pretrained encoder is evaluated on the unseen downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们在四个下游任务中,即森林语义分解、森林实例分解、树种分类和树龄回归方面,都独立地进行同样的LitePT主干,使用与相应的培训-切除基线相同的培训程序。 预训后,丢弃任务特定解码器或头,对预训编码器进行未见下游任务评价.

blocks.en: As in forest instance segmentation, we employ the ForestFormer3D ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) head, which jointly optimizes semantic and instance predictions. Consequently, transfer between these two tasks would not constitute an independent evaluation of representation transfer. We therefore exclude semantic-to-instance and instance-to-semantic transfer from our experiments.
blocks.zh: 与森林实例分类一样,我们采用了ForestFormer3D(Xiang等人,2025年)头,共同优化语义和实例预测。 因此,这两项任务之间的转移不会构成对代表转移的独立评价。 因此,我们从实验中排除了语义对语义和实例对语义的转移.

blocks.en: 3.4 Transfer learning
blocks.zh: 3.4 转移学习

blocks.en: Following pretraining, the pretrained LitePT encoder is transferred to downstream forestry tasks using either frozen probing or end-to-end fine-tuning.

blocks.en:
Frozen probing. To directly leverage the learned representations with minimal task-specific adaptation, we freeze the pretrained encoder and optimize only a lightweight task-specific prediction module. Depending on the downstream architecture, this prediction module may consist of a linear layer, a LitePT decoder, or a task-specific prediction head.
The specific probing configurations vary across downstream tasks and are described in Section 4 .
blocks.zh:
解冻问讯. 为了直接利用学习到的表达方式,用最小的任务特异性适应,我们冻结了预先训练的编码器,并且只优化一个轻量级的任务特异性预测模块. 根据下游架构的不同,这个预测模块可能包括线性层,LitePT解码器,或任务特定预测头.
具体的探测配置因下游任务而异,在第4节中有所描述。

blocks.en: End-to-end fine-tuning. To fully adapt the pretrained features to a downstream task, we initialize the LitePT encoder with pretrained weights and jointly optimize the entire model with the task-specific decoder or prediction head. The fine-tuning architecture is identical to that used for the corresponding training-from-scratch baseline.

blocks.en: Partial weights loading. Besides initializing the entire encoder, we also investigate partial weight initialization, where only the first k k stages of the pretrained LitePT encoder are loaded while the remaining stages are randomly initialized. This setting allows us to study how representations learned at different levels of the encoder affect the downstream transfer.
blocks.zh: 部分重量加载。 除了初始化整个编码器外,我们还调查了部分重量初始化,其中只有预训LitePT编码器的首个k k级被加载,而其余的阶段被随机初始化. 这种设置使我们能够研究在编码器不同级别学到的表述如何影响下游转移.

blocks.en: 3.5 Backbone and pretraining implementation
blocks.zh: 3.5 背骨和预培训的实施

blocks.en:
We use LitePT ( Yue et al., 2026 ) as our backbone across all experiments.
Following the recommendations of Wu et al. (2025) , we make the following modifications to improve its compatibility with self-supervised learning.
First, we replace the Batch Normalization ( Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015 ) layers in LitePT with Layer Normalization ( Ba et al., 2016 ) to improve training stability and enhance generalization to unseen datasets.
Second, we change the embedding layer from a single sparse convolution layer to a single linear layer. Lastly, LitePT adopts an encoder-decoder U-Net architecture, while pretraining is only performed on the encoder.
blocks.zh:
我们使用LitePT(Yue等人,2026年)作为我们在所有实验中的骨干.
根据吴等人(2025年)的建议,我们做了以下修改,以提高其与自我监督学习的兼容性.
首先,我们将LitepT中的Batch Normalization(Ioffe and Szegedy, 2015年)层替换为LetePT Normalization(Ba等人,2016年),以提高训练稳定性,增强对隐形数据集的概括性.
其次,我们把嵌入层从一个单一的稀疏的演化层改为一个单一的线性层. 最后,LitePT采用了编码器-解码器U-Net架构,而预训则只在编码器上进行.

blocks.en: Self-supervised pretraining is conducted on 64 NVIDIA GH200 GPUs with a total batch size of 128 for 30 epochs. We use a constant learning rate of 0.001, a weight decay of 0.0001, and a layer-wise learning rate decay factor of 0.9. The mask size is set to 5 cm with a mask ratio of 0.7, and grid sampling is performed using a 5 cm grid size. For EMA training, the student and teacher temperatures are set to 0.1 and 0.07, respectively, while the momentum is fixed at 0.994.

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 总体设置

blocks.en:
We consider four forestry downstream tasks: forest semantic segmentation, forest instance segmentation, tree species classification, and tree age regression.
Our experiments address two complementary questions. First, we investigate whether self-supervised pretraining improves downstream performance over training from scratch ( Sections 4.2 , 4.3 , 4.4 and 4.5 ). Second, we evaluate whether task-specific supervised pretraining learns transferable representations ( Section 4.6 ).

我们认为四项林业下游任务:森林语义分化、森林实例分化、树种分类和树龄回归。
我们的实验涉及两个相辅相成的问题。 首先,我们调查自我监督的预训是否从零开始改善下游的业绩(第4.2、4.3、4.4和4.5节)。 第二,我们评价具体任务监督的预训是否学习可转让表述(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, experiments are conducted under multiple annotation budgets to simulate different levels of supervision. The same annotation subsets are used across all methods to ensure fair comparisons. Depending on the downstream task, we consider training from scratch, frozen probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and where applicable, k k NN evaluation. Since dense prediction and global prediction tasks adopt different downstream architectures, the exact probing configurations are described in the corresponding task subsections.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,实验是在多个注释预算下进行的,以模拟不同级别的监督. 所有方法都使用同样的注释子集,以确保公平比较。 根据下游任务,我们考虑从零开始训练,冷冻检测,端到端微调,并酌情进行k k NN评价. 由于密集预测和全球预测任务采用不同的下游架构,因此在相应的任务小节中描述了精确的探测配置.

blocks.en: 4.2 Semantic segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.2 语义分割

blocks.en: Setup. In this task, we train a model to assign each point in a forest point cloud to three classes: wood, leaf, and ground. The different model variants are illustrated in Figure 6 . We employ a single linear layer as the segmentation head. As is standard for dense prediction, we employ a LitePT decoder to aggregate multi-scale features before the segmentation head, except in the linear probing setting, where the segmentation head operates directly on concatenated multi-scale encoder features.

blocks.en:
In the scratch setting, the encoder, decoder, and segmentation head are randomly initialized and trained from scratch.
In the linear probing setting, we freeze the pretrained encoder and train only the segmentation head.
In the decoder probing setting, we keep the pretrained encoder frozen while randomly initializing and jointly training the decoder and segmentation head.
In the fine-tuning setting, we initialize the encoder with pretrained weights, randomly initialize the decoder and segmentation head, and jointly optimize all modules.

在划痕设定中,编码器,解码器,和分割头被随机初始化,并从零开始训练.

在解码器探测设置中,我们保持预先训练的编码器冻结,同时随机初始化并联合训练解码器和分区头.
在微调设置中,我们以预训重量初始化编码器,随机初始化解码器和分片头,并联合优化所有模块.

blocks.en: In addition to learned evaluation, we employ a non-parametric segmentation k k -nearest neighbour ( k k NN) label-transfer protocol to directly measures semantic class separability in the learned feature space. To keep nearest-neighbour search tractable at the scale of forest point clouds, we operated on geometric superpoints ( Robert et al., 2023 ; Geist et al., 2026 ) rather than individual points. Each superpoint is represented by the mean of its constituent point features and labelled by majority vote over its full-resolution ground-truth labels. Superpoints extracted from the training scenes constitute a labelled reference bank. Each test superpoint is assigned the majority label of its k k nearest bank superpoints under cosine similarity in feature space, and predictions are propagated to full resolution via the point-to-superpoint map. We use k = 8 k=8 throughout the experiments.

blocks.en:
Results. Table 1 summarizes the forest semantic segmentation performance on the FOR-instanceV2 test set under varying proportions of labelled training data (5%-100%). Four main observations can be drawn. First, fine-tuning consistently outperforms training from scratch across all data regimes, demonstrating the effectiveness of semantic features learned during pretraining.  Second, the benefits of leveraging pretrained features is most pronounced in low-data regimes and gradually diminishes as the amount of labelled data increases, as further illustrated in Figure 7 .
This behavior is particularly desirable in practical applications, where labelled data is often scarce and pretraining provides the greatest benefit.
Third, in low-data settings (e.g., with only 0.15ha), the non-parametric k k NN probe outperforms all parametric baselines and remains competitive even when the full 5.71ha training data is used. This pattern is coherent: when labels are scarce, k k NN has no parameters to overfit and simply reads out the class structure already embedded in the frozen features.
Finally, in terms of performance per-class, the wood class remains the most challenging in all settings. Fine-tuning leads to the most significant improvements for this class, underscoring the importance of pretrained representations in capturing complex structural patterns.

blocks.en: Figure 8 presents qualitative semantic segmentation results obtained using the k k NN probe. The first column shows the superpoint partitioning. Using finer superpoints could further improve segmentation performance, albeit at the expense of increased computational cost. Despite this extremely simple, training-free protocol, the method already achieves strong semantic segmentation performance, indicating the learned feature space effectively separates semantic classes. The learned representation is robust in challenging environments where both large and small trees coexist. As shown in the last row, it delivers strong segmentation results on the BlueCat dataset, which was acquired using terrestrial laser scanning (TLS). TLS data were never used in pretraining, demonstrating that the learned representation generalizes well to point clouds acquired by unseen sensing modalities.

blocks.en: We further compare the qualitative semantic segmentation results obtained with different training strategies using 0.81ha (20%) labelled training data in Figure 9 . The visualization includes forest scenes acquired by different sensing platforms: NIBIO (ULS), NIBO_MLS (MLS), and BlueCat (TLS). The qualitative results are consistent with the quantitative trends reported in Table 1 . Specifically, both simple k k NN and linear probing produce reasonably strong segmentation results, while fine-tuning consistently outperforms training from scratch. For example, in the first row, the model trained from scratch fails to segment the stem of a bent tree, whereas the finetuned model produces a more accurate stem segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用图9中标注的0.81ha(20%)培训数据,将定性语义分类结果与不同的培训战略进行比较。 可视化包括不同感知平台获得的森林场景:NIBIO(ULS),NIBO_MLS(MLS)和BlueCat(TLS). 质量结果与表1所报告的数量趋势一致。 具体来说,简单的k k NN和线性探测都产生合理的强分化结果,而微调则始终从头超过训练。 例如,在第一行中,从零开始训练的模型未能将弯曲的树干分割开来,而微调的模型则会产生更准确的树干分割.

blocks.en: Beyond data efficiency, we also examine training efficiency. Figure 10 (a) shows the validation mIoU over training epochs of the three training strategies: training from scratch, linear probing, and fine-tuning. Both fine-tuning and linear probing, which leverage pretrained representations, achieve strong performance early in training, demonstrating significantly faster convergence compared to training from scratch. In particular, fine-tuning consistently attains the highest mIoU throughout training and converges to the best final performance. Linear probing also benefits from pretraining, achieving competitive accuracy within only a few epochs, highlighting the effectiveness of the pretrained features in resource-constrained settings. In contrast, training from scratch requires substantially more epochs to achieve comparable performance and exhibits less stable optimization in the early stages. Overall, these results highlight the advantage of pretraining in accelerating convergence, improving stability, and enabling strong performance even with minimal training.
blocks.zh: 除了数据效率之外,我们还审查培训效率。 图10(a)显示三种培训战略的培训历程对mIoU的验证:从零开始的培训、线性测试和微调。 微调和线性测试都利用了预先训练的表述,在早期的训练中都取得了强效的成绩,显示出与从零开始的训练相比,融合速度明显快. 特别是,微调在培训过程中始终达到最高的MIOU,并趋于最佳最终业绩。 线性测试还得益于预训,仅在几个世纪内实现了竞争精度,突出了预训功能在资源约束环境下的有效性. 与此相反,从零开始的培训需要更多的时间才能在早期阶段实现可比较的绩效和表现不太稳定的优化。 总体而言,这些成果突出了预训在加快融合、改善稳定性和即使在最低限度的培训下也能取得良好业绩方面的优势。

blocks.en: 4.3 Instance segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 实例分割

blocks.en: Setup. In this task, given a forest point cloud as input, the goal is to segment individual trees by assigning each point to a unique instance ID corresponding to a specific tree, while treating the ground as background. We adopt ForestFormer3D ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , the current state-of-the-art method that jointly performs semantic segmentation and individual tree segmentation.
blocks.zh: 设置. 在这一任务中,考虑到森林点云作为投入,目标是将每个点分配到与特定树对应的独特实例ID,同时将地面当作背景,从而分割单个树木。 我们采用了ForestFormer3D(Xiang等人,2025年),即目前联合进行语义分化和单个树分化的先进方法.

blocks.en: ForestFormer3D originally employs a Sparse U-Net ( Graham et al., 2018 ; Choy et al., 2019 ) as backbone for feature extraction. The backbone features are passed to two parallel MLP heads: one learns instance discriminative features, and the other predicts tree versus non-tree classifications, which are used to sample instance queries. These sampled instance queries, together with learnable semantic queries are then processed by a Transformer-based query decoder to produce individual tree masks and semantic segmentation outputs. ForestFormer3D adopts a two-stage training strategy, where the two MLP heads are pretrained before jointly training the full model.
blocks.zh: 森林前景3 D最初使用Sparse U-Net(Graham等人,2018年;Choy等人,2019年)作为地物提取的骨干. 骨干特征传递给两个平行的 MLP 头:一个学习实例歧视特征,另一个预测树与非树分类,用于样本实例查询. 这些抽样实例查询,加上可学习的语义查询,然后由一个基于变形器的查询解码器处理,以产生单个树面具和语义分割输出. 森林前景3 D采取两阶段培训战略,在联合培训整个模式之前,对工党的两名领导人进行预先培训。

blocks.en: In our implementation, we replace the original backbone with LitePT, a high-performing and lightweight backbone. With this modification, we observe that directly training the full model end-to-end from the start yields better performance while simplifying the training pipeline, removing the need for the two-stage procedure. Additionally, for improved training efficiency, we pre-chunk two large forest scenes (BlueCat and Yuchen) to facilitate data sampling. During inference, we follow the protocol of ForestFormer3D by sampling overlapping cylindrical regions and merging predictions across blocks based on confidence scores.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实施中,我们用LitePT取代原来的骨干,这是一个高性能和轻量级的骨干. 通过这一修改,我们发现,从开始就直接培训整个模式的端到端都会产生更好的业绩,同时简化了培训管道,从而不再需要两阶段程序。 此外,为提高培训效率,我们将两个大型森林场景(蓝猫和Yuchen)进行预选,以便利数据取样。 在推论期间,我们遵循ForestFormer3D的规程,对重叠的圆柱形区域进行取样,并根据置信分数将各区块的预测合并.

blocks.en:
The training configurations are illustrated in Figure 6 .
In the scratch setting, all weights in the LitePT-enhanced ForestFormer3D are randomly initialized.
In the head probing setting, we freeze the pretrained encoder and train only the ForestFormer3D prediction head from random initialization.
In the decoder probing setting, we keep the pretrained encoder frozen, while randomly initializing and jointly training the decoder and the ForestFormer3D prediction head.
In the fine-tuning setting, we initialize the encoder of LitePT with pretrained weights. Notably, instead of loading weights of all encoder stages, we find that initializing only the first two stages yields the best performance, and we adopt this strategy for this task. The decoder and ForestFormer3D prediction head are randomly initialized, and all modules are optimized jointly.

图6说明了培训的配置。
在刮伤设定中,LitePT-增强的ForestFormer3D中的所有权重都随机初始化.
在头部探测设置中,我们冻结了预先训练的编码器,只从随机初始化中训练ForestFormer3D预测头.
在解码器探测设置中,我们保持预先训练的编码器冻结,同时随机初始化并联合训练解码器和ForestFormer3D预测头.
在微调设定中,我们以预训重量初始化了LitePT的编码器. 值得注意的是,我们发现,最初只有两个阶段才产生最佳业绩,而不是加载所有编码器阶段的权重,我们为这项任务采取了这一战略。 解码器和ForestFormer3D预测头是随机初始化的,所有模块都是联合优化的.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Previous studies on forest point cloud instance segmentation ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Wielgosz et al., 2024 ; Henrich et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ; Wielgosz et al., 2026 ) commonly evaluate performance using the F1 score. A predicted instance is counted as a true positive (TP) if its best-matching ground-truth instance yields IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 and that ground-truth instance has not already been matched by a higher-confidence prediction; otherwise it is a false positive (FP). False negatives (FN) are ground-truth instances that remain unmatched. Precision and recall are then defined as: Precision \displaystyle\mathrm{Precision} = TP TP + FP , \displaystyle=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}}\;, (10) Recall \displaystyle\mathrm{Recall} = TP TP + FN , \displaystyle=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}}\;, (11) and the F1 score is their harmonic mean: F1 = 2 × Precision × Recall Precision + Recall . \mathrm{F1}=\frac{2\times\mathrm{Precision}\times\mathrm{Recall}}{\mathrm{Precision}+\mathrm{Recall}}\;. (12) A second metric commonly reported is mean coverage (Cov), which measures how well each ground-truth instance is recovered. Given ground-truth instances 𝒢 = { g 1 , … , g N g } \mathcal{G}=\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{N_{g}}\} and predictions 𝒫 = { p 1 , … , p N p } \mathcal{P}=\{p_{1},\ldots,p_{N_{p}}\} , each g i g_{i} is assigned its best-overlapping prediction and the resulting IoU is averaged: Cov = 1 N g ​ ∑ i = 1 N g max j ⁡ IoU ⁡ ( g i , p j ) , \mathrm{Cov}=\frac{1}{N_{g}}\sum_{i=1}^{N_{g}}\max_{j}\mathrm{IoU}(g_{i},p_{j})\;, (13) computed per plot and averaged across plots. Since overlap enters directly rather than through a threshold, partially recovered trees still contribute proportionally.

blocks.en:
However, neither protocol characterises segmentation quality completely. The F1 score reflects performance at a single IoU threshold and ignores mask quality at other levels of overlap, while Cov is recall-oriented: it is computed per ground-truth instance and therefore does not penalise spurious predictions. Moreover, neither metric makes use of the confidence scores that rank predictions.
In the computer vision literature, it is more established to report average precision (AP) metrics, which evaluate performance over multiple recall levels and IoU thresholds. This provides a more comprehensive, application-agnostic assessment of segmentation quality. Here, we adopt AP-based metrics as the primary evaluation criteria. Predicted instances are ranked by their confidence scores in descending order. Cumulative TP and FP counts are computed along this ranked list, yielding a precision–recall curve. AP is the area under this curve approximated by 101-point interpolation following the COCO evaluation protocol ( Lin et al., 2014 ) : AP = 1 101 ​ ∑ r ∈ { 0 , 0.01 , … , 1.0 } max r ~ ≥ r ⁡ P ⁡ ( r ~ ) , \mathrm{AP}=\frac{1}{101}\sum_{r\in\{0,\,0.01,\,\ldots,\,1.0\}}\max_{\tilde{r}\geq r}P(\tilde{r})\;, (14) where P ⁡ ( r ~ ) P(\tilde{r}) denotes the measured precision at recall level r ~ \tilde{r} . AP@25 and AP@50 evaluate this curve at IoU matching thresholds of 0.25 and 0.50, respectively. AP@25 captures coarse detection ability, which is useful for assessing whether the model identifies the approximate spatial extent of individual trees. AP@50 enforces stricter spatial agreement and is more sensitive to precise delineation of tree boundaries. To provide a threshold-agnostic summary, we also report the COCO mean Average Precision (mAP), computed by averaging AP across ten IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05: mAP = 1 10 ​ ∑ t ∈ { 0.50 , 0.55 , … , 0.95 } AP t . \mathrm{mAP}=\frac{1}{10}\sum_{t\in\{0.50,\,0.55,\,\ldots,\,0.95\}}\mathrm{AP}_{t}\;. (15) This metric rewards models that produce not only correctly detected but also precisely delineated tree instances, making it a comprehensive indicator of overall instance segmentation quality. When directly comparing with prior forest point cloud studies, we also report the F1 score for completeness.

然而,两个协议的特性都没有完全分化质量。 F1分反映了单IoU阈值的性能,忽略了其他级别重叠的遮罩质量,而Cov则是面向召回的:它是按地面真实实例计算的,因此不会惩罚虚假的预测. 此外,两个衡量标准都没有利用将预测排在前列的信心分数。
在计算机视觉文献中,比较确定的是报告平均精度(AP)度量衡,该度量衡在多个召回水平和IoU阈值上评价性能. 这为分解质量提供了更加全面、应用不可知的评估。 在这方面,我们采用基于行动方案的衡量标准作为主要评价标准。 预测的事例按其信心分数的降序排列。 累计的TP和FP计数按此排名列表计算,得出精度-召回曲线. AP是这一曲线下的区域,大约为COCO评价协议之后的101点插值(Lin等人,2014年) :AP=1 101 ∑ r → {0, 0.01,.,.,1.0 }最大 r → → r → P → (r ~ ),\mathrm{ AP}=\frac{1}{101}\sum_{r\in\{0,\,0.01,\,\,ldots,\,1.0\}}\x_{\tilde{r}\geq r}(\tilde{r})\;(14)表示在召回级别上测量到的精度 r ~\tilde{r}. AP@25和AP@50分别以IoU比对0.25和0.50的阈值评价这一曲线. AP@25捕获粗细的探测能力,这对评估模型是否识别单个树的大约空间范围很有用. AP@50执行更严格的空间协议,对精确划定树木边界更为敏感. 为了提供阈值不可知性摘要,我们还报告COCO平均值精度(mAP),通过10个IOU阈值的平均值AP从0.50到0.95, 分为0.05级: mAP = 1 10 ∑ t { { 0.50, 0.55, ..., 0.95 } AP t. mathrm{ mAP}=\frac{ 1}{10 }\sum_{t\ in \{ 0.5 0.50,\ 055,\ ldots,\ 0.95\}}\ mathrm{ AP}_{t}\ ; (15) 这一衡量奖励模式不仅能正确检测,而且能准确界定树木实例,使其成为整体实例分解质量的全面指标。 在直接与之前的森林点云研究进行比较时,我们也报告F1的分数是否完整.

blocks.en: Results. Table 2 reports the instance segmentation performance on the FOR-instanceV2 test set under varying proportions of labelled training data (5%-100%). In the low-data regime (0.29ha), fine-tuning provides a clear advantage over training from scratch, improving mAP from 26.6 to 28.2, highlighting the effectiveness of pretrained representations for instance-level understanding when annotations are limited. This observation is further supported by the qualitative results shown in Figure 11 , where the models are trained only using 1.35ha (20%) labelled data. Both training from scratch and fine-tuning produce reasonable segmentation results, while fine-tuning yields more accurate instance predictions, correcting under-segmented trees, reducing incorrect instance assignments, and better preserving fine-grained details.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表2根据不同比例的培训数据(5%-100%),报告FOR-InstanceV2测试集的实例分解性能。 在低数据制度(0.29ha)中,微调比从零开始的培训具有明显的优势,将mAP从26.6提高到28.2,突出了预先培训的表述的有效性,例如在说明有限时的层次理解。 图11显示的质量结果进一步支持了这一观察,图11只使用1.35ha(20%)标记的数据对模型进行培训。 从零开始的培训和微调都产生合理的分解结果,而微调则产生更准确的实例预测,纠正分解不足的树木,减少不正确的实例分配,更好地保存精细的细节.

Comparison of training from scratch and fine-tuning from the self-supervised pretrained backbone. Each ground-truth tree is given a unique color; predicted instances are matched to ground-truth via maximum-IoU Hungarian assignment and share the color of their matched ground-truth tree. blocks.en: As the amount of labelled data increases, however, the performance gap between fine-tuning and training from scratch narrows. In higher-data regimes, training from scratch slightly outperforms fine-tuning. This suggests that, given sufficient labelled data, models trained from scratch can effectively learn instance-level representations without relying on pretraining. This behavior contrasts with the trends observed in our standalone semantic segmentation experiments in Section 4.2 , where fine-tuning remains beneficial even with the full training set. Overall, these results suggest that the benefit of pretraining depends on both the downstream task and the amount of labelled data available.
blocks.zh: 但是,随着标注数据数量的增加,微调和培训之间的性能差距从零开始缩小。 在较高数据制度中,从头到尾的培训略微优于改进。 这表明,只要有足够的标注数据,从零开始训练的模型就可以有效地学习实例层面的表述,而不必依赖预先培训。 这一行为与我们在第4.2节中独立语义分解实验中观察到的趋势形成对比,该节的微调即使在完整的训练集中仍然是有益的. 总的来说,这些结果表明,预训的好处取决于下游任务和可获得的标注数据的数量。

blocks.en: Finally, we compare our approach with state-of-the-art methods in Table 3 . Since our instance segmentation framework jointly predicts instance and semantic segmentation, we report results for both tasks from a single model. On the full training set, LitePT- scratch slightly outperforms ForPT- finetune , while both variants surpass the previous best results in F1 score for individual tree segmentation and mIoU for semantic segmentation.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们将我们的方法与表3中最先进的方法进行比较。 由于我们的实例分解框架共同预测实例和语义分解,我们从一个单一模式报告这两项任务的结果。 在全套训练中,LitePT-抓略优于ForPT-微调,同时两种变体都超过了以往在F1分数中单个树分数和mIoU分数的最佳成绩.

blocks.en: 4.4 Species classification
blocks.zh: 4.4 物种分类

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Model variants for single-tree species classification and age regression. The task head is a lightweight MLP.
blocks.zh: 图12:单树种分类和年龄回归模式变体. 任务头是一个轻量级的MLP.

blocks.en:
Setup. In this task, the model takes a single-tree point cloud as input and predicts its species. For efficiency, each tree is subsampled to 8,192 points using farthest point sampling.
Following the adaptation strategies shown in Figure 12 , we consider scratch training, linear probing, and fine-tuning.
We use a lightweight MLP as the classification head.
In the scratch setting, the classification head is attached to the encoder output, and all network weights are randomly initialized.
In the linear probing setting, the pretrained encoder is frozen, and global pooling is applied to the concatenated multi-scale encoder features, followed by a linear layer for classification.
In the fine-tuning setting, we initialize the encoder of the backbone with pretrained weights and train the model end-to-end. For the fine-tuning setting in this task, we again observe that partially loading pretrained weights is beneficial; specifically, initializing the first three encoder stages yields the best performance.
blocks.zh:
设置. 在这个任务中,模型采用单树点云作为输入并预测其物种. 为了提高效率,每棵树都采用最远点采样方式被抽查到8,192分.
按照图12所示的适应战略,我们考虑抓痕训练、线性探测和微调。
我们使用轻量级的MLP作为分类头.
在划痕设定中,分类头被附在编码器输出上,所有网络权重都随机初始化.
在线性探测设置中,预先训练的编码器被冷冻,全球集合被应用到调和的多尺度编码器特征上,然后是进行分类的线性层.
在微调设置中,我们以预训重量初始化骨干编码器,并训练模型端到端. 对于这项任务的微调设置,我们再次指出,部分装入预先训练过的重量是有好处的;具体地说,初始化前三个编码阶段产生最好的性能。

blocks.en: Additionally, we report results obtained using a non-parametric k k NN probe. We run the frozen encoder, concatenate the multi-scale features and apply global average pooling to build a feature bank from all labelled training trees. Each test tree is classified by a majority vote over its k k nearest bank entries under cosine similarity. We use k = 1 k=1 for all data fractions, as larger k k is biased towards frequent species in the long-tailed dataset.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们报告使用非参数k k NN探测器获得的结果。 我们运行冷冻的编码器, 凝固多尺度的特性, 并应用全球平均集合 来从所有标注的训练树上建立一个特性库。 每棵试验树以多数表决的方式,将其最接近的kk的银行条目划入同位素相似度之下。 我们对所有的数据分数使用k=1k=1,因为较大的kk偏重于长尾数据集中的频繁物种.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Tree species classification results on FOR-species20K validation set. Comparison of training from scratch and transfer from the self-supervised pretrained backbone. Values in parentheses (shown once in the top block) denote each setup’s trainable / total parameters, which are identical across data fractions.
blocks.zh: 表4:FOR-species20K验证集上树木物种分类结果. 从零开始的培训与从自监管的预先培训骨干转移的比较。 括号中的值(在顶部块中显示一次)表示每个设置的可训练/总参数,这些参数在数据分数上是相同的。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We report mean class accuracy (mAcc) and overall accuracy (allAcc), following the same definitions as in the semantic segmentation evaluation, as defined in Equations 8 and 9 . mAcc evaluates the averaged classification performance across all species and therefore is less sensitive to class imbalance and long-tail species distributions. In contrast, allAcc measures the overall classification accuracy across the entire evaluation set and is more influenced by dominant species classes with larger numbers of samples. Reporting both metrics provides a comprehensive evaluation of classification performance for both balanced per-class prediction and overall dataset-level accuracy.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们报告的平均分类精确度(mAcc)和总体精确度(allAcc),遵循与方程式8和9定义的语义分区评价相同的定义。 mAcc评价所有物种的平均分类性能,因此对分类失衡和长尾物种分布不太敏感. 相比之下,所有Acc测量整个评价集的整体分类精度,并受到样本数量较多的优势物种类别的影响较大. 报告这两个衡量标准都对分类业绩作了全面的评价,既能平衡地进行每类预测,又能全面准确地进行数据集。

blocks.en: Results. Table 4 presents the tree species classification performance on the FOR-species20K validation set under varying proportions of labelled training data (1%-100%). In the extremely low-data regime (only 141 trees, 1%), both fine-tuning and linear probing outperform training from scratch, demonstrating the clear benefit of pretrained representations when labelled data are scarce. As the amount of labelled data increases, the performance gap between fine-tuning and training from scratch gradually diminishes. Nevertheless, pretraining continues to provide important advantages in terms of optimization efficiency. Specifically, Figure 10 (b) shows the validation overall accuracy over training epochs for the three training strategies when 100% data is used. Both fine-tuning and linear probing achieve strong performance early in training, exhibiting significantly faster convergence and more stable optimization compared with training from scratch. These results demonstrate that even when the final performance differences between fine-tuning and training from scratch are small, pretraining substantially improves training efficiency by accelerating convergence and stabilizing optimization, making it particularly advantageous in resource-constrained or time-sensitive scenarios.
blocks.zh: 结果。 表4根据不同比例的标签培训数据(1%-100%),列出了FOR-Species20K验证组的树种分类性能。 在极低的数据体系中(只有141棵树,1%),微调和线性测试都从头到尾都超越了训练,表明在贴有标签的数据稀缺时,预先训练过的表示明显有好处. 随着标注数据数量的增加,从零开始微调和培训之间的性能差距逐渐缩小. 尽管如此,预训在优化效率方面继续提供重要优势. 具体地说,图10(b)显示在使用100%数据时,三个培训战略的培训阶段的总体准确性。 微调和线性测试在培训初期都取得了强劲的成绩,与从零开始的培训相比,融合速度明显加快,优化更稳定. 这些结果表明,即使从零开始微调和培训之间的最后业绩差异很小,预先培训也通过加快趋同和稳定优化而大大提高了培训效率,使其在资源紧张或时间敏感的情况下特别有利。

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Per-class accuracy gain of fine-tuning the self-supervised pretrained backbone over training from scratch at epoch 20 , plotted against the number of training samples per class for six data regimes. Each point represents one tree species. Dashed lines show linear regression fits (r and p-value annotated); classes where both models scored zero are excluded from regression.
blocks.zh: 图13:每班精度收益 精细调整自监管的预训骨干,而不是从头到尾的训练 20 期,与六个数据系统的每班培训样本数量相对应。 每个点代表一个树种. 虚线显示线性回归(r和p值附加说明);两个模型均得零分的类从回归中排除.

blocks.en: As FOR-species20K exhibits a pronounced long-tail distribution, we further analyze the per-class accuracy gain of fine-tuning over training from scratch. Figure 13 plots the accuracy improvement (fine-tuning minus scratch) against the number of training samples per class at epoch 20 across different training data regime (1%-100%). Overall, we observe a negative correlation between accuracy gain and the number of training samples per class, particularly in low-data regimes. The fitted correlation is negative in every one of the six label regimes ( r r between − 0.02 -0.02 and − 0.38 -0.38 ), although no individual regime reaches statistical significance (all p > 0.10 p>0.10 ). It is therefore the consistency of the sign across six independent label regimes, rather than any single fit, that suggests fine-tuning provides larger improvements for underrepresented classes, where learning from scratch is more challenging due to limited supervision. These results suggest that pretraining improves overall performance in part by mitigating the long-tail effect, disproportionately benefiting classes with fewer training samples. This property is practically valuable in real-world ecological datasets, where class imbalance is common and rare species are of high importance.
blocks.zh: 由于FOR-species20K显示明显的长尾分布,我们进一步分析从零开始细化训练的每班精度收益. 图13根据不同培训数据系统20世纪(1%-100%)的每期培训样本数量,列出了准确度的提高(微调减划痕)。 总体而言,我们观察到准确性提高与每期培训样本数量之间的负相关性,特别是在低数据制度中。 在六个标签制度中,每个标签制度(r r在−0.02-0.02和−0.38-0.38之间)的对应关系都是负的,尽管没有单个标签制度具有统计意义(所有标签制度都 > 0.10 p>0.10)。 因此,在六个独立的标签制度中,而不是在任何单一的标签制度中,标志的一致性表明,微调能为任职人数不足的班级提供更大的改进,由于监督有限,从零开始学习更具挑战性。 这些结果表明,预训部分地通过减轻长尾效应提高了总体绩效,使培训样本较少的班级受益不成比例。 在现实世界的生态数据集中,这种财产实际上很有价值,在这些数据集中,阶级不平衡是常见的,稀有物种具有很高的重要性.

blocks.en:
We further compare our approach with previous state-of-the-art methods on the FOR-species20K dataset. For benchmarking purposes, we make the following modifications to the setup we used in the data-efficiency experiments. First, instead of subsampling each tree to 8,192 points, we use full point cloud as input, which improves final performance. Second, we remove the slight random rotation augmentation around x x and y y axes, as it incurs significant computational overhead when processing full point clouds. Third, we utilize all officially provided development data from FOR-species20K for training.
As shown in Table 5 , LitePT- scratch and ForPT- finetune outperform all previous methods on this benchmark. LitePT- scratch achieves an overall accuracy of 82.7%, while fine-tuning the pretrained ForPT backbone further increases the accuracy to 83.2%, achieving the best performance across all reported metrics. In the frozen-feature setting, ForPT- linear probing achieves an overall accuracy of 68.7%, demonstrating that the learned representations retain useful information for tree species classification even without fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步比较了我们的方法与FOR-species20K数据集上以前最先进的方法. 为了制定基准,我们对数据效率实验中使用的设置作如下修改。 首先,我们不是对每棵树进行子抽样到8,192分,而是使用全点云作为输入,这提高了最终性能. 第二,我们删除xx和y轴周围的微小随机旋转增量,因为处理全点云时会产生重大的计算间接费用。 第三,我们利用FOR-20K所有官方提供的发展数据进行培训。
如表5所示,LitePT-抓取和ForPT-微调优于该基准上以往所有方法。 LitePT-刮伤达到82.7%的总精度,同时精细调整预训的ForPT主干线进一步将精度提高到83.2%,实现了所有报告度量的最好性能. 在冷冻地貌设定中,ForPT-线性探测总体精度达到68.7%,表明所学的表示法即使没有微调,也保留了树种分类的有用信息.

blocks.en:
Setup. In this task, the model takes a single-tree point cloud as input and predicts its age. As in the species classification task, each tree is subsampled to 8,192 points using farthest point sampling before being fed into the model.

We use a lightweight MLP as the regression head.

In the fine-tuning setting, we initialize the encoder of the backbone with pretrained weights and train the model end-to-end. Same with the fine-tuning strategy with species classification, we only initialize the first three encoder stages.

blocks.en: Results. Table 6 reports tree age regression performance on the FOR-age validation set under different training data fractions. When only 62 trees (5%) or 125 trees (10%) are available for training, linear probing substantially outperforms both training from scratch and full fine-tuning. With larger training sets, full fine-tuning becomes increasingly effective and achieves the lowest RMSE in the 20% and 50% data regime. Figure 14 show the scatterplots of the predicted vs reference age when 625 trees (50%) are used for training.

In comparison, the model training from scratch exhibits a larger spread around the reference line, whereas linear probing shows greater underestimation of older trees. All the three plots show larger prediction errors for old trees, likely reflecting their underrepresentation in the long-tailed age distribution of the training data.

Overall, linear probing is most effective in the low-data regime, whereas full fine-tuning becomes the preferred strategy as the amount of the labelled training data increases.

blocks.en: 4.6 Cross-task transfer from supervised pretraining
blocks.zh: 4.6 从受监督的预训中跨任务转移

blocks.en: In the previous sections, we compared self-supervised pretraining against training from scratch for each downstream task. Here, we investigate the transferability of task-specific supervised pretraining. Specifically, we reuse the fully supervised models trained for the corresponding training-from-scratch baselines in Sections 4.2 , 4.3 , 4.4 and 4.5 as source-task pretrained models. After discarding the task-specific prediction module, the pretrained encoder is transferred to the remaining unseen downstream tasks through frozen probing. We compare these representations against self-supervised pretrained backbones. To isolate representation quality with minimal task-specific adaptation, we adopt linear probing for forest semantic segmentation, tree species classification, tree age regression, and head probing for forest instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 在前几节中,我们将自我监督的预训与每项下游任务从零开始的培训进行比较。 在这里,我们调查具体任务监督预训的可转移性。 具体地说,我们重新利用第4.2、4.3、4.4和4.5节中为相应的培训抽查基线而培训的完全监督模型,作为源任务预先培训的模型。 丢弃任务特定预测模块后,预训编码器通过冷冻检测转移到其余未见的下游任务. 我们把这些陈述与自我监督的事先训练的骨干相比较。 为了将表现质量与特定任务的最小调整隔离开来,我们对森林语义分类、树种分类、树龄回归、以及森林实例分类的头部检测采用线性检测方法。

blocks.en: Figure 15 summarizes the overall cross-task transferability. Across all four downstream tasks, self-supervised pretraining consistently produces the most transferable representations, outperforming task-specific supervised pretraining under the same probing protocol. In contrast, supervised pretraining remains strongly task-dependent: no single supervised source task transfers consistently well across all unseen downstream tasks. These results suggest that self-supervised pretraining is a more promising strategy for learning generic representations and moving toward foundation models for forest point clouds.
blocks.zh: 图15总结了总体跨任务可转让性。 在所有四个下游任务中,自我监督的预训始终产生最可转移的表述,比同一检测协议下的具体任务监督预训表现好。 与此相反,受监督的预训仍然非常依赖任务:没有单一的受监督的源任务在未见的下游所有任务之间一致转移。 这些结果表明,自我监督的预训是学习通用表述和走向森林点云基础模式的更有希望的战略。

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Cross-task transfer of frozen representations under varying annotation budgets. All probes for pretrained representations are linear except head probing for instance segmentation.
blocks.zh: 图16:不同附注预算下冻结陈述的跨任务转移。 预先训练的表示物的所有探测器都是线性的,但头部探测器除外,例如分化.

blocks.en:
Figure 16 further analyzes transferability under different annotation budgets. Interestingly, models pretrained on tree species classification or tree age regression achieves higher linear probing performance on forest semantic segmentation than self-supervised pretraining in low-data regimes.
This suggests that supervision from species classification and age regression encourages representations that capture semantically meaningful tree characteristics useful for semantic segmentation.
Nevertheless, this benefit does not generalize consistently to the other downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
图16进一步分析了不同注释预算下的可转移性。 有趣的是,对树种分类或树龄回归进行预先培训的模型,在森林语义分类方面的线性测试性能高于低数据制度中自我监督的预先培训。
这表明,从物种分类和年龄回归中进行监督,会鼓励能够捕捉对语义分化有用的具有明显意义的树木特征的表示。
然而,这种好处并没有一致地概括到其他下游任务。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Analysis and ablation studies
blocks.zh: 5.1 分析和衰减研究

blocks.en: Learned representations. We visualize the learned representations through self-supervised pretraining in Figure 17 . Specifically, we concatenate multi-scale encoder features and project them into a three-dimensional space using principal component analysis (PCA), which is then used as per-point color for rendering.
blocks.zh: 学习的表述。 我们通过图17中自我监督的预训来想象所学的表述。 具体来说,我们利用主组件分析(PCA)将多尺度的编码器特性组合起来,并将其投射为三维空间,然后作为每个点的颜色用于渲染.

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Learned representations through self-supervised pretraining. Concatenated multi-scale encoder features are projected into a three-dimensional space using PCA, which is used as per-point color for rendering.
blocks.zh: 图17:通过自我监督的预训取得的陈述。 混凝土的多尺度编码器特征被投射到一个使用PCA的三维空间中,用于渲染的每点颜色.

blocks.en: As shown in the PCA visualizations, different semantic components are clearly distinguishable: leaves, wood, and ground exhibit distinct feature (color) values, indicating that the model learns separable representations for each class. Importantly, these features are not solely driven by height. For example, in scenes where trees vary significantly in height, the learned representations remain more consistent with vegetation components than with their vertical position. This suggests that self-supervised pretraining captures semantically meaningful features, which also offers an explanation why a simple k k NN or linear probe already achieves largely correct semantic segmentation.
blocks.zh: 如PCA可视化所示,不同的语义成分可以明显区分:叶子,木质,地面呈现出不同的特征(颜色)值,表明模型会学习每个类的可分离的表示. 重要的是,这些特征并非完全由高度驱动。 例如,在树高差异很大的场景中,所学的表示仍然与植被成分比起其垂直位置更加一致. 这说明自我监督的预训会捕捉到有目的的特征,这也解释了为什么简单的k k NN或线性探测器已经实现了大体正确的语义分解.

blocks.en: Model scaling. In the main experiments, we pretrain LitePT-S (12.4M parameters). To study the effect of model scaling, we further pretrain a larger variant, LitePT-B (44.4M parameters). The results on forest semantic segmentation are shown in Figure 18 . Overall, scaling the model consistently improves performance across all training strategies and evaluation metrics. The improvements are especially notable in the linear probing setting, where mIoU increases from 84.2 to 85.8, indicating that larger pretrained models encode more expressive and transferable features. While scaling also leads to improved performance in both scratch and fine-tuning settings, the gains are relatively modest compared to the increase in model size. Therefore, considering the trade-off between performance and efficiency, we recommend LitePT-S as a practical choice for most applications.
blocks.zh: 模型缩放。 在主要实验中,我们预演LitePT-S(12.4M参数). 为了研究模型缩放的效果,我们进一步预演了一个更大的变体LitePT-B(44.4M参数). 森林语义分类结果见图18。 总的来说,推广这一模式不断改进所有培训战略和评价衡量标准的业绩。 这些改进在线性探测设置中尤其显著,mIoU从84.2增加到85.8,表明更大的预试模型编码更具有表达性和可转让性。 虽然规模化还导致在刮痕和微调情况下的性能得到改善,但与模型规模的增加相比,收益相对较低。 因此,考虑到性能和效率之间的权衡,我们建议将LitePT-S作为大多数应用的实际选择.
