blocks.zh: 图18:森林语义分区模型缩放。 我们比较了预训LitePT-S编码器(12.4M)和LitePT-B编码器(44.4M). 从零开始的培训与从自监管的预先培训骨干转移的比较。

blocks.en: Figure 19 : Validation performance over training epochs when partial loading different stages of the self-supervised pretrained encoder , on (a) semantic segmentation (mIoU, %); (b) tree species classification (overall accuracy, %).
blocks.zh: 图19:当部分装入自我监督预先训练的编码器不同阶段时,在(a) 语义分类(mIoU,%);(b) 树种分类(总体准确性,%)方面,验证表现超过培训时期。

blocks.en:
Partial loading of pretrained weights. For certain downstream tasks (e.g., forest instance segmentation and tree species classification), we observe that, under the fine-tuning setup, loading only a subset of pretrained weights (rather than the entire model) improves performance.
In Figure 19 , we analyze the impact of partially loading pretrained encoder stages during downstream transfer learning. LitePT-S ( Yue et al., 2026 ) consists of five encoding stages, and we progressively load pretrained weights from shallow to deeper stages (e.g., enc0-1 indicates loading stages 0 and 1). As shown in Figure 19 (a), for semantic segmentation, loading more stages generally improves performance and accelerates convergence. In contrast, for species classification as shown in Figure 19 (b), loading all pretrained stages leads to faster convergence but a lower final performance, whereas loading only early stages results in better final accuracy at the cost of slower convergence. Empirically, loading pretrained weights up to the third stage (i.e., enc0-2) provides the best trade-off between convergence speed and final performance.
blocks.zh:
部分装入预训重量. 对于某些下游任务(例如森林实例分化和树种分类),我们观察到,在微调设置下,只装入一个子集的预先训练的重量(而不是整个模型)可以提高性能.
在图19中,我们分析在下游转移学习过程中部分加载预装编码器阶段的影响. LitePT-S(Yue等人,2026年)由五个编码阶段组成,我们逐渐加载从浅层到深层的预加载重量(例如enc0-1表示加载阶段0和1). 如图19(a)所示,在语义分解方面,加载更多的阶段一般会提高性能并加速趋同. 相比之下,就图19(b)所示的物种分类而言,加载所有经过预先训练的阶段都会导致更快的趋同,但最终性能较低,而只加载早期阶段则导致更准确的最终性,而降低趋同的速度。 从经验上看,加载到第三阶段(即enc0-2)的预加载重量,为汇合速度和最终性能提供了最佳的权衡.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that the hierarchical encoder captures representations at different levels of abstraction: early stages primarily encode local geometric structures and fine-grained details, whereas deeper stages focus on more global and shared semantic features. For semantic segmentation, these high-level semantic features are particularly beneficial, whereas for instance-discriminative tasks such as species classification, local geometric cues are more informative, and high-level shared semantics may be less relevant or even detrimental to adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,分级编码器捕捉不同抽象层次的表示:早期主要编码局部几何结构和精细细细的细节,而更深层次则侧重于更加全球性和共享的语义特征. 就语义分类而言,这些高层次语义特征特别有益,而例如物种分类等区别性任务,局部几何提示信息比较丰富,高层次共享语义可能不太相关甚至不利于适应.

blocks.en: Based on these findings, we recommend selectively loading pretrained weights according to the specific requirements of the downstream task, balancing the benefits of pretrained representations with task-specific adaptability.
blocks.zh: 根据这些调查结果,我们建议根据下游任务的具体要求,有选择地装载预先训练过的重量,平衡预先训练过的表述与具体任务适应性的好处。

blocks.en: 5.2 Limitation and future work
blocks.zh: 5.2 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Instance-aware features. In this work, we observe that pretraining is particularly beneficial for semantic-oriented tasks. For instance-discriminative tasks, pretraining also provides gains, but primarily in low-data regimes and often requires end-to-end fine-tuning. When large-scale labelled data is available, the benefits of pretrained representations diminish and may even hinder effective adaptation.
blocks.zh: 案例意识特征. 在这项工作中,我们看到预训对语义导向的任务特别有益. 例如,歧视性任务,预先培训也提供了收益,但主要是在低数据制度中,往往需要端到端的微调。 在有大规模标签数据的情况下,预先训练好的表述的好处会减少,甚至可能妨碍有效的适应。

blocks.en: This observation is consistent with our PCA visualizations of the learned representations through self-supervised pretraining in Figure 17 , which suggest that the model predominantly captures global, shared semantic features rather than instance-discriminative cues. We attribute this behavior to the current pretraining objective, which biases the model toward learning high-level shared semantics without sufficiently preserving fine-grained, instance-level distinctions ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . In the future work, we plan to design improved pretraining strategies that explicitly encourage instance-aware representations, thereby better supporting a wider range of downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 这种看法与常设仲裁院通过图17中自我监督的预训对学到的表述的可视化一致,图17表明该模型主要捕捉全球共享的语义特征,而不是实例歧视提示。 我们将此行为归结为当前训练前目标, 将模式偏向于学习高水平的共享语义, 在今后的工作中,我们计划设计更好的培训前战略,明确鼓励注重实例的表述,从而更好地支持更广泛的下游任务。

blocks.en:
Robustness to arbitrary grid sizes. We use LitePT as the backbone for pretraining.
Following common practice in modern point cloud processing, the input point cloud is first discretized via grid sampling to obtain a fixed spatial resolution before being processed by the neural network. This step reduces the number of points and standardizes point density.
blocks.zh:
强力至任意网格大小. 我们使用LitePT作为预训的骨干.
遵循现代点云处理的常见做法,输入点云首先通过网格取样盘点,在神经网络处理前获得固定空间分辨率. 这一步骤减少了点数,使点密度标准化.

blocks.en:
However, this design introduces an implicit constraint during downstream adaptation: using the same grid size as in pretraining typically yields the best performance, whereas deviations in grid size (and thus point density) can reduce the benefits of pretraining.
In the future work, we plan to mitigate this by incorporating strategies such as random grid-size augmentation during pretraining, with the goal of improving robustness to varying point densities.
blocks.zh:
然而,这种设计在下游适应过程中引入了隐含的制约:使用与预训相同的网格大小通常产生最佳性能,而网格大小的偏差(因此点密度)可以减少预训的好处.
在今后的工作中,我们计划通过在预训期间纳入诸如随机电网大小扩增等战略来缓解这种情况,目的是提高稳健度,使其达到不同密度。

blocks.en: Geographic generalization. Our downstream evaluations are primarily conducted on datasets from Europe, reflecting the geographic bias of currently available and well-established benchmarks for forest point cloud understanding. Moreover, the majority of our pretraining data also originates from Europe. Consequently, the generalization of the learned representations to forests in other geographic regions remains insufficiently evaluated. Ideally, the model should be assessed on datasets from diverse regions, such as Asia, Africa, or South America. However, such evaluation is currently limited by the lack of well-established forest point cloud benchmarks with suitable annotations in these regions. Expanding both pretraining data and downstream evaluations to more geographically diverse forests is therefore an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 地理概论. 我们的下游评价主要是对来自欧洲的数据集进行的,反映了现有和既定的森林点云理解基准的地域偏差。 此外,我们大多数的预训数据也来自欧洲。 因此,对其他地理区域森林方面所得经验的概括评价仍然不足。 理想的情况是,应当根据亚洲、非洲或南美洲等不同区域的数据集评估该模型。 然而,这种评价目前受到限制,因为这些区域缺乏有适当说明的既定森林点云基准。 因此,将培训前数据和下游评价扩展至地域多样性更强的森林是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This work presents a systematic study of large-scale representation learning for forest point clouds through both self-supervised and supervised pretraining. We show that self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and improves downstream performance under limited annotation budgets. While task-specific supervised pretraining benefits closely related downstream tasks, self-supervised pretraining learns more transferable representations, providing the strongest foundation for cross-task transfer. Together, these findings suggest that large-scale self-supervised pretraining is a promising paradigm for forest point cloud understanding. At the same time, our results indicate that learning strongly instance-discriminative representations remains an important open challenge for current pretraining methods. Future work will explore scaling pretraining to global-scale and more diverse forest datasets, enhancing representation learning for instance-level discrimination, improving robustness to varying point densities and acquisition conditions, and extending pretrained representations to a broader range of ecological applications. Ultimately, we envision foundation models that provide a unified representation for general-purpose 3D forest understanding.
blocks.zh: 这项工作通过自我监督和监督的预训,对森林点云的大规模代表性学习进行了系统研究。 我们显示,自我监督的预训加快了模式的趋同,并在有限的注释预算下改善了下游的业绩。 具体任务监督的预训惠益与下游任务密切相关,而自我监督的预训则学习了更多的可转移表述,为跨任务转移提供了最坚实的基础。 这些调查结果表明,大规模自我监督的预先训练是了解森林点云的一个有希望的模式。 同时,我们的结果表明,学习强烈的事例歧视表述仍然是目前培训前方法面临的一个公开挑战。 今后的工作将探索将预先培训扩大到全球规模和更加多样化的森林数据集,加强代表性学习,例如程度歧视,提高稳健度,达到不同密度和获取条件,并将预先培训的代表性扩大到更广泛的生态应用。 归根结底,我们设想了一些基础模式,为三维森林的通用理解提供统一的代表性。
